description: The exact price of a product with the chosen options and quantity, for delivery in Spain: excl. IVA, the IVA (21 %) and the total, plus the prices of the other quantities. Options left out take the default.

options.description: Option key -> value id, from get_product, e.g. {"papel":"mate350"}.

quantity.description: One of the quantities of get_product, e.g. "500".
